remarks: You will be welcomed home daily by a lovely garden and front porch to this completely updated One Bedroom Springdale Unit. Living Room with new floor, new window blinds & freshly painted; Large Eat-In-Kitchen with new Quartz counters, new tile back splash, new sink new Stainless Gas Range, Stainless Refrigerator approx. 18 months old, new floor, new light fixtures & freshly painted. Bedroom with new floors, new window blinds & freshly painted. Full newly tiled Bathroom with shower over tub, new sink & vanity, new light fixture, new floor & freshly painted. Attached to the Kitchen is an enormous Pantry/Storage Area. A back door leads to the newly painted garage that has an area for the brand new washer & dryer. Located near RR Station, Great Restaurants & Shopping areas. Be the first to enjoy this newly updated unit. Credit Score 700+ required. Absolutely no pets.
